lead_raw_text:
The trigonal structure of Ta3Ge9Se15 (reduced formula TaGe3Se5) adopts space group R-3m (No. 166) with 27 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Ta centers coordinated by six Se neighbors, while Ge shows both 3-neighbor and 12-neighbor (close-packed-like) environments and Se adopts 4- or 5-coordinate geometries. Polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner- and edge-sharing between Ta octahedra and between Ge and Ta polyhedra, with the neighbor graph forming a single three-dimensional component.
